_comment: The engine hoist, the core's so every setting can stand one in its garage: the model from the Sketchfab model in its credit (CC BY 4.0: its maker is named in the game's credits, Settings). The core's garages have no place for it; a setting gives its places with a prop.json of this id naming no model, which keeps this one (docs/modding.md, props).
